subject: Live pairing: ML infra coding session - coordination and handoff
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Rivera <ethan.rivera@gmail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Live pairing: ML infra coding session - coordination and handoff

Hi Ethan,

Thanks again for taking the time to do the live pairing with us. We want to keep this focused and low-friction: 30 minutes total, pair-programming on a short infra/feature task (no take-home). Proposed slots (Pacific):
- Tue 5/25 10:00–10:30 PT
- Tue 5/25 15:00–15:30 PT
- Wed 5/26 09:00–09:30 PT

We plan to use our CoderPad environment (link attached below) and have one interviewer join as driver and one as observer. Please let us know which slot works and whether you prefer macOS/Linux environment (we can switch the container).

Quick logistics:
- Platform: CoderPad (https://coderpad.io/room/ZYX-1234)
- Please have your resume accessible for reference (you can upload here).
- Proctoring is light — we’ll share a short debrief afterward.

Attaching a brief pairing-instructions PDF and a copy of the resume we have on file. If you have any accessibility needs or time constraints, tell us and we’ll adjust.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: pairing-instructions.pdf (PDF), ethan_rivera_resume.pdf (PDF)
From: Ethan Rivera <ethan.rivera@gmail.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Zephyr Robotics Recruiting <talent@zephyr-robotics.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Live pairing: ML infra coding session - coordination and handoff

Hi Sergio — thanks for the note. I can do Tue 5/25 at 15:00 PT. Linux container is fine.

Two quick questions:
1) Will I need API keys or any repo access in advance?
2) Is the session recorded? I’m happy to proceed but wanted to check recording policy.

Thanks,
Ethan

Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Live pairing: ML infra coding session - coordination and handoff

Hi Ethan — great, we’ve locked 5/25 15:00 PT. Calendar invite sent (you should see it from Redwood Interviewing).

Answers to your questions:
- No repo or API keys needed. The task is self-contained in the CoderPad session; we’ll provide any small fixtures during the session.
- We don’t record live pairing sessions. We do ask interviewers to complete a short debrief form afterward (link below).

Links:
- CoderPad: https://coderpad.io/room/ZYX-1234
- Debrief form (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFG-pairing-debrief
- Calendar event: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=sergio-livepair-ethan-20270522

On session day please join the CoderPad 5 minutes early. If anything changes, reply here and we’ll pivot.

Thanks and looking forward,
Monica Patel
Recruiting Coordinator, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

Attachment: pairing-instructions.pdf (contains environment checklist and short sample problems)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Rivera <ethan.rivera@gmail.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 07:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Live pairing: ML infra coding session - coordination and handoff

Adding a quick interviewer note — I’ll be the primary interviewer (driver) and Sergio will join as observer/follow-up questions. If Sergio has to drop, Lauren Bishop is our fallback for observer coverage.

Pairing plan:
- 0–2 min: quick introductions and problem restatement
- 2–25 min: pair-programming (Markus drives, candidate navigates)
- 25–30 min: wrap + clarifying questions

Debrief: please fill out the short rubric in the drive folder within 24 hours so we can close loop with the panel and send feedback. Monica — I linked the internal rubric in the drive.

Thanks everyone — see you Tuesday.

Markus Klein
Engineering Manager, Inference Serving
markus.klein@redwood.ai
